title: R0_QUESTIONNAIRE — Medical history: cancers and benign tumours (pseudonymised)
description: Minimally processed pseudonymised metadata (TCode instead of StudyID, shifted dates, PII removed, letter codes as numbers) from mh_cancers_benign_tumors.json containing Cancers and benign tumours other than in the breasts, including leukaemia, Hodgkin's disease and other lymphoma, collected at baseline.

OtherCancersBenignTumors.title: Other cancers and benign tumours (not in the breasts)
OtherCancersBenignTumors.description: One entry per cancer or benign tumour other than in the breasts, including leukaemia, Hodgkin's disease and other lymphoma, up to 3, in the order reported. The first is printed on page 24; further ones go on page 15:1 and are flagged by R0_MoreNonBreastCancers.

default: S02:p.24 Q8:1 Have you ever been diagnosed with any other type of cancer or a benign tumour

R0_OtherCancerBenignTumors_Num.title: Which cancer or tumour this entry refers to (1st, 2nd, 3rd)

R0_OtherCancerBenignTumor.title: Whether the participant has been diagnosed with another cancer or benign tumour (other than in the breasts)
R0_OtherCancerBenignTumor.description: Whether the participant was diagnosed with this other (non-breast) cancer or benign tumour.
R0_OtherCancerBenignTumor.$comment: Source coding: 0 More than one option chosen; 1 Yes; 2 No. The 2nd and 3rd are the same question for the later cancers (page 15:1).

default: S02:p.24 Q8:1 Have you ever been diagnosed with any other type of cancer or a benign tumour (other than in the breasts), including leukaemia, Hodgkin's disease or other lymphoma? Yes No

R0_MoreNonBreastCancers.title: Diagnosed with a non-breast cancer more than once
R0_MoreNonBreastCancers.description: Flag indicating the participant has had more than one non-breast cancer/benign tumour diagnosis.
R0_MoreNonBreastCancers.$comment: Tick box. Source coding: 1 Flagged (dictionary AnswerText 'Checked').

default: S02:p.24 Q8:1 If you have been diagnosed with non-breast cancer more than once, please cross here and give details, as in question 8:1, on page 15:1 More than once

R0_MoreNonBreastCancers.x-universe: Only completed when another cancer or benign tumour was reported (the first entry's yes/no is 1); the box is under 'If yes'.

allOf.$comment: Skip pattern R109: in each entry whose own yes/no is not Yes (0 or 2), the year, the age, the part of the body, the type, the hospital, the town and the second part and type are structurally not applicable and carry the sentinels. Questionnaire p.24 Q8:1: 'If yes, when was this diagnosed?'. It is written here, not in the entry's own allOf, to keep the routings of this topic together.

default: S02:p.24 Q8:1 If 'yes', when was this diagnosed?

allOf.$comment: Skip pattern R110: when the first entry is not Yes (0 or 2), there is no later cancer and the 'more than once' box is structurally not applicable -- OtherCancersBenignTumors holds at most one entry and R0_MoreNonBreastCancers carries the missing-numeric sentinel. Questionnaire p.24 Q8:1: 'If no, go to question 8:2'.

default: S02:p.24 Q8:1 If 'no', go to question 8:2
